Alice Ng: Heads-up — after landing the kernel-selector heuristic (prefer-fused-softmax=true) I'm seeing repeated memory growth on long AWQ FP8 chat sessions. 2 runs -> OOM on a 48GB node. Profiling attached below.
Ben Ortiz: ugh. repro steps?
Alice Ng: repro is simple: serve awq-gptq-6b-fp8, run ~1k incremental tokens with streaming. trace: 
```
REDWOOD_SERVE_BIN --model awq-gptq-6b-fp8 --batch-size 1 --streaming true --profile /tmp/profile.pb
# client: chat-injector --steps 1000 --seq 2048
```
nvprof snapshot (trimmed):
```
GPU memory before: 22.8 GB
peak after kv allocation: 37.9 GB
cudaMalloc calls: repeated small allocs ~1-2MB each (hot path within fused_softmax_kern)
```
perf-bot: Automated summary: allocation churn detected; fragmentation score high (0.64); top culprits: fused_softmax_kern, kv_pack_unaligned, compact_realloc.
Cara Li: interesting — AWQ FP8 uses packed 4-bit representation with custom kv packing. Kernel change probably forced a different packing path that allocs unaligned buffers. Any differences in kv_cache_dtype config?
Alice Ng: default was kv_cache_dtype: "auto" (runtime picked fp8->stored-as-u8 packed). I tried forcing fp16 and it reduced peak by ~800MB but latency regressed ~6ms.
Dan K: that matches my hunch. fused_softmax_kern expects aligned 16B strides for fast GEMM fast paths; when kv is packed we end up with temporary upcasts and per-layer scratch that avoids reuse. Two angles: 1) allocator-level: increase small-block slab retention so reuse catches these temporaries; 2) kernel-selection: if model.quantized && kv_packed then steer to unpacked-friendly kernel that has smaller scratch.
Ben Ortiz: can you paste the config you used for the fp16 force? also paste the minimal allocator env toggles you tried.
Alice Ng: config I flipped: 
```
{"serve": {"model": "awq-gptq-6b-fp8", "kv_cache_dtype": "fp16", "kernel_selector": {"prefer_fused_softmax": true}}}
```
allocator envs tried: `REDWOOD_ALLOC_SMALL_SLAB_MS=5000`, `REDWOOD_ALLOC_SOFT_RESERVE=0.12`, `REDWOOD_ALLOC_EVICT_WINDOW=30`
Cara Li: quick proposal for kernel selector: add an early check that inspects `model.meta.kv_packed == true` and `kv_cache_dtype != fp16` then lower fused-softmax priority by one slot. Pseudocode: 
```
if model.meta.kv_packed and kv_cache_dtype == "fp8":
  score[fused_softmax] -= 10
```
This avoids the big scratch path.
Dan K: allocator tweak I'd push immediately: make small slab reuse more aggressive for transient <8MB buffers created within inference window. Implement: `compact_sweeper_granularity=512k`, `transient_retention_ms=12000`. That should allow the temporary upcasts to reuse freed blocks instead of triggering new cudaMalloc.
Ben Ortiz: can we benchmark both? I can run a quick A/B: baseline, kernel-selector-patch, allocator-tweak, both combined. I expect combined fixes to be best.
Alice Ng: ran a quick A/B earlier:
- baseline (prefer_fused=true, kv auto): peak 38.1GB, 1 OOM/5 runs
- kv_cache_dtype=fp16: peak 31.9GB, latency +6ms
- allocator: compact_sweeper_granularity=512k transient_retention_ms=12000: peak 33.2GB, no OOM, latency unaffected
- both allocator + kernel-selector patch (simulated): peak 30.8GB, latency +2ms
Ben Ortiz: nice. Can you dump the profile difference (hot alloc sites)? I want to see if cudaMalloc is reduced.
Alice Ng: attached snippet from heap profiler: 
```
alloc_site: fused_softmax_kern.scratch -> count 1243 -> total 1.1GB
alloc_site: kv_unpack_temp -> count 992 -> total 0.9GB
alloc_site: compact_realloc -> count 230 -> total 0.5GB
```
After allocator tweak counts drop ~60% for small allocs.
Cara Li: follow-up: long-term we should consider a kv-cache dtype policy: prefer storing kv as fp16 on-host for AWQ/GPTQ unless the model certifies packed-read fast path. Add metric that flags when pack->unpack churn exceeds X and suggest config.
Dan K: agree. I can PR two things: (A) kernel-selector conditional (small diff), (B) more aggressive compact_sweeper default for quantized models behind a feature flag `QUANT_SAFEGUARD`.
Ben Ortiz: file an issue with repro and attach the profile + the A/B numbers. I'll run a 12h soak on a few nodes.
Alice Ng: done — issue #4123 (link: https://redwood.internal/issue/4123). Patch branch `fix/kv-frag-sweeper-4123`.
perf-bot: CI regression check queued for branch `fix/kv-frag-sweeper-4123`.
Alice Ng: tl;dr action items: 1) Dan PR kernel-selector conditional, 2) Dan PR allocator defaults behind QUANT_SAFEGUARD, 3) Ben soak + perf verify, 4) Cara add kv dtype telemetry + config suggestion to Optimize.
Ben Ortiz: +1. I'll report back by EOD after soak. :thumbsup:
Cara Li: adding a small doc blurb for Optimize on best kv_dtype choices.
Alice Ng: thanks all — this feels like a solid mitigation path. :heart:
summary: Thread about memory growth / OOM for AWQ FP8 after kernel-selector changes; team discusses repro, profiling, allocator tweaks, kernel-selection heuristic, kv_cache_dtype tradeoffs, and next actions.
